description: Stable row id <prompt_id>__<model>__a<attempt> (pilot_range rows: <prompt_id>__<model>__range_a<attempt>); never renumbered across dataset versions.
Prompt id (join key to prompts.csv and blocks.csv). n### = new prompt; tr_p### = regeneration of a reconstructed competition train prompt; v1_g### = prompt_bank_v1 re-issue.
The competition label of the model that wrote the passage (one of the 18 Name That LLM labels).
The passage exactly as returned by the API (no cleaning, no truncation).
Per-generation target length N sent as '(about N words)' (length_mode target); empty when the prompt carried a shared range '(words min-max)'.

new (prompts written for this dataset), new2 (prompts written in the register of the reconstructed competition prompts), train_regen (reconstructed competition train prompts), new_kimi_nothink (kimi-k3 re-run on `new` with reasoning disabled), proxy_v1 (Kaggle-proxy rows on earlier prompts), pilot_range (pilot rows with the shared length range).
Route that produced the row: anthropic (first-party API), openai (first-party API), openrouter (first-party provider pinned), vertex (Google Vertex AI), kaggle_proxy (Kaggle Benchmarks Model Proxy).
For train_regen: the competition prompt_id (join to the competition's train.csv inside a Kaggle notebook); for v1_regen: the prompt_bank_v1 id.
